flags: PARTIAL ROUTE OVERVIEW: NCDOT files 00/01 stop before the relevant pages; longer file 21 also stops before Mill Bridge. Removed current’s Sherrills Ford/Kerr Mill/Millbridge/Corriher Springs turn sequence. A source-backed end-to-end drive cannot be supplied from this cache.

Moments arranged west-to-east on the catalog’s approach to Mill Bridge, with Mount Ulla/Bear Poplar and Kerr Mill treated as excursions. Exact junction order is unverified because route pages are absent; material’s next strip anchor is Woodbridge Run, for which no cache page supplies a usable narrative.

Preserved the Mount Ulla title and township coordinate; its subject is the Bear Poplar community mural, not the store. The inherited point is not a verified mural location. Kerr Mill’s cache coordinate appears inconsistent with its described location; retained current’s omission of at.

Dropped the unsupported about 50 people per square mile and museum designation for Kerr Mill; cache verifies restoration and county park use. Material credits Dr. Samuel Kerr as builder, but the mill article names Joseph and identifies Samuel as his successor.

Mount Ulla community, township and postal area have different boundaries. Omitted speculative name origins and avoided calling colonial settlement the first human settlement. Retained story and Kerr Mill gristmill motifs.
